class.name: OcgAspectNeutralwindow
class.brief_description: Defines a platform-neutral window. This class is intended to be used in context when window management (including OpenGL context creation) is performed on application side (e.g. using external framework).
class.description: ! Defines a platform-neutral window. ! This class is intended to be used in context when window management (including OpenGL context ! creation) is performed on application side (e.g. using external framework). ! ! Window properties should be managed by application and assigned to this class as properties.

method.name: Aspect_NeutralWindow
method.description: Empty constructor. Note that window is considered "mapped" by default.

method.name: Map
method.description: Change window mapped flag to TRUE.

method.name: Unmap
method.description: Change window mapped flag to FALSE.
